title.zh: A DeFi giant that once held $3 billion is now proposing to wind itself down

current_state.zh: Balancer DAO is voting on a proposal to wind down operations, ending new development and eventually distributing treasury to BAL holders, following a $128 million exploit and failed recovery efforts.
